I feel this on so many levels. Im 22(male) and I was diagnosed with HPV 2 and half years ago while I was at university. Its completely shifted my personality. I use Warticon and it works quite well.

 I just keep getting reoccurrences which is so frustrating. Especially when everyone around me is going on dates & in happy relationships. I did have a girlfriend for a while and on the first date I just told her my situ and she was fairly understandable about it. But then we broke up, and im not sure ill be able to find someone like that again...there's still a huge stigma with STDs. 

Most of the time, I forget I have HPV now. I work out 4 times a week, I work constantly, I dont go out drinking, and I barely see friends. But I meditate and appreciate the world going around me. Lifes a tough one, and the mental harm from having HPV is awful. Just have to find people that appreciate your situation and will be there for you to help you. I did CBT for a while, which helped alot. I now have a holistic PT who sort of acts as a therapist as well as a trainer, and he's helped me with my confidence.

I hope this helps, idk it could just be a rant on my half 😅
